mentions.name: Networks by Analogy
mentions.description: A book that teaches computer networking through analogies, written as the resource the author wishes they had while struggling with networking in school and early in their career.
mentions.problem: Networking is difficult to grasp early in one's education and career; the book addresses this by explaining the subject through analogies.
mentions.source_excerpt: I wrote a book about networking, but told through analogies. I spent a lot of my school and early career struggling a bit with networking in general, and I had the opportunity to grow my career and meet people through it that taught me a lot. This is the book I wish I had early on. https://networksbyanalogy.com/
mentions.author: __warlord__
